rationale: This index is built entirely on on-chain holder behavior and miner economics — no price-derived or sentiment metrics. NUPL (35%) and MVRV (25%) are the primary signals because they directly measure the aggregate profit/loss state of all holders relative to their cost basis, which historically pinpoints both capitulation bottoms (NUPL<-20, MVRV<0) and euphoria tops (NUPL>65, MVRV>5). RHODL (20%) adds cycle-position context: it's near-zero during deep accumulation phases and explodes exponentially at tops, so log-scaled breakpoints are essential. Puell (10%) catches miner-distress bottoms independent of holder behavior and often leads price recovery. CVDD (10%) provides a final sanity check on the relationship between coin age and price. Buy threshold of 28 targets deep bear-market accumulation zones (NUPL < 5, MVRV near zero), while sell threshold of 70 fires well before maximum euphoria to avoid FOMO-driven overstay — the 2021 double-top showed that NUPL can hit 65-70 at the SECOND top before real collapse. DCA entry over 3 tranches/6 weeks respects the fact that on-chain bottoms often have multiple capitulation wicks (2018 bottomed and retested; 2022 had LUNA then FTX), while lump-sum exits are justified because tops are sharp and waiting for confirmation means leaving returns on the table. Min 7 days in buy zone prevents acting on one-day spikes into the zone.
